groups.why_chosen: Starting from a prompt, the draft model branches topK candidate tokens at each of Draft_Depth levels, building a probability-scored tree; only the Tokens_to_Verify highest-confidence tokens in that tree (highlighted blue) are ultimately sent to the target model for verification.
